chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): Did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) enter the state of Ihram at night or during the day? He said, 'Rather, during the day.' I said, 'At which time?' He said, 'At the time of the Dhuhr prayer.'

key_terms.أَحْرَمَ: Entered the state of Ihram (ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah)

ai.seo_question: What time of day did the Prophet enter Ihram for Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the Sunnah of entering Ihram during daylight hours, specifically aligning it with the Dhuhr prayer time, which provides a practical model for the timing of Hajr rituals. It highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) adherence to the natural rhythm of the day for spiritual transitions, a detail preserved by scholars like Shaykh al-Tusi to guide juristic rulings on the validity of night versus day Ihram.
